propositions: setup-uv fetches the artifact-URL manifest on every CI job despite uv version being pinned locally, because downloadVersion unconditionally calls getArtifact before checking tool cache
GitHub-hosted runners start each job with an empty uv tool cache, guaranteeing a cache miss and triggering the unconditional manifest fetch via fetchManifestResponse to raw.githubusercontent.com
A local committed manifest does not suppress the fetch because Node fetch() rejects file: URLs, forcing the network call even when version is resolved from pyproject.toml
The network fetch failure mode that killed run 33214025855 remains reachable on every job despite the v56b7 pin, because the pin removed only version-resolution fetches, not artifact-URL fetches

Approach B (repo-local composite action with committed sha256 direct download from Astral release URL) eliminates the per-job raw.githubusercontent.com manifest fetch while retaining only the release-CDN binary download dependency
